claims.reasoning: Dobbins is a committee back wearing a vet's name tag, cut him loose. Braelon Allen's RB1 in waiting the second Breece Hall sits, and I feel that one in my bones — no handcuff cosplay, just the next bellcow walking through the door.

Keenan Allen dropped 15.3 on the league last week and Harry's sitting there with $62 burning a hole in his pocket getting ready to overpay for the exact same name — not happening on my watch, I'm taking it off the board first. Golden's a rookie with training wheels, Allen's a name I actually like saying.

trade_offer.message: Harry — Cam Ward AND Michael Wilson for Bijan Robinson. I'm doing you a favor here, you get two guys who actually show up, I get the one I've been wanting since draft night. Take the deal before I change my mind and just take him anyway.

forum_post: 3-0 and nobody's said a word about it because there's nothing TO say — I called my shots, I'm cashing them. Harry, you're up this week, and I already went and bought the best name on the wire before your $62 could waddle over and overpay for him like you did Kamara. You've got Hall of Fame busts riding your bench collecting dust — I've got Henry and Mahomes putting up 20s and a quarterback room so deep I'm using guys as currency. Kris, darling, you're welcome in advance for whatever happens Sunday. George, Selina, I didn't mention you because I didn't need to. See everybody in the box score.
